jobs.description:
Job Description

About the role

As a Product Quality Engineer, you will be expected to step into the game and display your excellent quality mindset to help drive our innovations beyond industry standards

What you will do

- Represent the Quality Management within the development team
- Correlate the SiC failure mechanisms with reliability measures to be implemented into the product quality
- Support the definition and execution of qualification activities for SiC product developments
- Contribute to the implementation of quality procedures and quality standards (Nexperia, JEDEC, AEC, and customer-specific) within projects
- Support the development, review, and verification of final test specifications
- Promote quality awareness and best practices to internal and external stakeholders
- Support customer requests and complaints handling activities
- Contribute to the identification and resolution of quality gaps in the product creation process
- Support the definition of qualification requirements and qualification of manufacturing processes
- Maintain documentation and handle data in analysis tools for Reliability, Yield, FMEA, Customer Requests, and related activities
- Perform analyses to identify root causes of yield loss or production issues and support the implementation of containment and corrective actions
- Prepare initial input for PCNs, support review and release activities, and contribute to follow-up actions

What you will need

- Master’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Physics or a similar discipline
- Experience in a similar position is desirable and experienced in wafer fab and assembly processes preferred
- Knowledge in semiconductor physics as well as in semiconductor applications in the SiC domain
- First knowledge of international quality standards and policies e.g. AEC-Q101, AQG 324
- Familiar with measurement methods and equipment as well as device testing environments
- Familiar with standard software tools (e.g. Office), problem solving techniques
- High-quality mindset and ability to work under pressure
- Fluent spoken and written English skills
- Strong know how in statistical data analysis
- Good communication and presentation skills
- Good team player and willingness to travel
- Assertiveness and demonstrated influencing skills
- Open mindset, which welcomes changes and views problems as opportunities

As a Quality Conformance Manager (d/m/w) in Hamburg, the role focuses on quality assurance, structured problem solving and process excellence within a global operations and training environment. The position coordinates quality notifications and corrective actions across the spare parts and kits portfolio while serving as an important interface between international teams, technical experts and customer-facing functions.

- Monitor, validate and analyse incoming Notification of Escape (NOE) and Quality Survey Report (QSR) requests, assessing their operational impact on spare parts and kits.
- Define, coordinate and implement rapid containment measures to mitigate quality defects and prevent non-conforming items from affecting customer operations.
- Manage Discrepancy Reports related to NOE, QSR and CAPRI processes, ensuring that quality tasks are validated, assigned, tracked and closed efficiently.
- Coordinate Airworthiness Directive analysis and resolution, including the structured assessment of safety-related items and the implementation of appropriate follow-up actions.
- Represent QSR processes during internal and external quality audits and demonstrate compliance with applicable aerospace quality standards.
- Work with international colleagues and global expert networks to align containment activities, exchange specialist knowledge and resolve complex quality topics.
- Contribute QSR expertise to cross-functional transformation initiatives, process management activities and continuous process improvement projects.
- Support customer satisfaction by applying structured problem-solving methods and maintaining a consistent focus on quality, reliability and timely resolution.
VORAUSSSETZUNGEN:

- Completed technical education or a relevant qualification in aircraft construction, engineering, or aerospace; comparable expertise in an aerospace-related discipline is suitable.
- Several years of professional experience in aircraft manufacturing, aerospace mechanics, quality management, quality assurance, maintenance, or upkeep/maintenance services.
- Practical knowledge of process improvement, process management, and Total Quality Management, including structured problem-solving methods.
- Experience in analyzing quality deviations, coordinating containment activities, and driving corrective actions through to completion.
- Ability to work independently, organize priorities effectively, and maintain a high level of attention to detail when handling complex quality topics.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills for working in multifunctional teams and with international expert networks.
- Confident German and English language skills for professional communication in a global working environment.
- Working conditions include full-time employment with 35 hours per week.
Benefits:

- An unlimited employment contract
- 35-hour workweek
- 30 days of annual leave
- An annual salary of around 72.000 €
- An attractive package following the Equal Pay model
- Flexible handling of overtime through compensatory time-off or payment

As a Supplier Quality Manager (d/f/m) in Hamburg, you will work across the cabin perimeter and help safeguard reliable supplier performance throughout the aerospace supply chain. The role combines Supply Chain, Logistics, supplier quality, risk management and continuous improvement activities in an international operating environment.

Your tasks:

- Monitor supplier delivery, quality and cost performance using relevant key performance indicators, and initiate immediate containment actions where required to protect industrial operations.
- Coordinate and follow up on recovery plans with suppliers when delivery reliability or product quality declines.
- Support the industrial qualification of products and suppliers in line with supplier requirements and applicable airworthiness, safety and industrial standards.
- Conduct industrial supplier audits and assessments, documenting findings and coordinating appropriate improvement measures.
- Develop the capacity and capabilities of cabin suppliers through continuous-improvement approaches, including APQP, Lean methods and joint supplier-development activities.
- Monitor new product introductions and transfers of work across the Lieferkette to maintain end-to-end consistency and on-time, on-quality performance.
- Identify and manage industrial risks in cooperation with internal and external stakeholders, applying structured Risikomanagement and Total Quality Management principles.
- Manage interfaces with program teams, final assembly operations and other internal stakeholders, while communicating effectively with contacts at different levels of supplier organizations.
VORAUSSSETZUNGEN:

- Completed studies or comparable qualifications in aerospace, engineering, industrial engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics or a related technical or commercial discipline.
- Practical experience in Lieferantenmanagement, Supply Chain Quality, Qualitätsmanagement or Qualitätssicherung; experience in the Luft- und Raumfahrt environment is advantageous.
- Sound understanding of quality-management methods and tools such as APQP, Control Plans, PFMEA, 8D/9S, VSM or comparable problem-solving approaches.
- Knowledge of Supply Chain processes, supplier performance management, industrial qualification, audits and continuous-improvement activities.
- Experience with Risikomanagement and TQM, meaning Total Quality Management, including the structured analysis of causes, risks and improvement measures.
- Confident use of Windows-based working environments and SAP/R3; familiarity with Google Workspace is also expected.
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to quickly understand functional processes, dependencies and operational interrelationships.
- Independent, structured and results-oriented approach, combined with reliable deadline and workflow coordination.
- Very good German and business-fluent English skills; French is an advantage.
- Willingness to travel worldwide up to approximately once per month is required.
- Full-time employment with 35 hours per week.

- An annual salary of around 75.000 €
- An attractive package following the Equal Pay model
- Flexible handling of overtime through compensatory time-off or payment
